tools.name: solarplus_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id: name, email, phone, full address, status, source, business name, categories and notes. SolarPlus API: GET /api/contact/{id}.

tools.name: solarplus_list_contact_fields
tools.description: List the built-in contact fields with name, label, type, required flag and select options. Use it before creating or updating contacts. SolarPlus API: GET /api/contact/fields.

tools.name: solarplus_list_custom_contact_fields
tools.description: List the custom contact fields this company set up, with the name to use in custom_fields. SolarPlus API: GET /api/contact/custom-fields.

tools.name: solarplus_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact (a lead by default). Required: first name, last name, email and full address. Creates a new record in the SolarPlus CRM. SolarPlus API: POST /api/contact.

tools.name: solarplus_update_contact
tools.description: Change the given fields of one contact. Fields you leave out keep their current value. SolarPlus API: POST /api/contact/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: solarplus_get_contact · Private data: solarplus_get_contact, solarplus_list_contact_fields, solarplus_list_custom_contact_fields, solarplus_create_contact, solarplus_update_contact · Public sink: solarplus_get_contact, solarplus_create_contact, solarplus_update_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: solarplus_get_contact · Private data: solarplus_get_contact, solarplus_list_contact_fields, solarplus_list_custom_contact_fields, solarplus_create_contact, solarplus_update_contact · Public sink: solarplus_get_contact, solarplus_create_contact, solarplus_update_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
